threads.title: The Balance
threads.intro: Separate a stale dashboard from money that really left the fund.
threads.outcome_text: The grant was ₹42,000 and the original reserve payment is PAY-712.

threads.title: The Gateway
threads.intro: Compare the gateway rows and the audit trail and test the routine-retry explanation.
threads.outcome_text: The destination fingerprint changed and a manual override let the replacement through.

story_events.title: Zero on the dashboard
story_events.body: The ledger credits ₹42,000 and debits supplier payments, then the reserve payment PAY-712 is reversed and a replacement debit follows. The snapshots show the dashboard emptying overnight.

story_events.title: The same approval, twice
story_events.body: PAY-712 and PAY-712B both cite APR-103. The registry approved ₹12,000 for the emergency equipment reserve at Northstar Equipment.

story_events.title: Not a retry
story_events.body: The gateway shows PAY-712 to DEST-NORTH-44 rejected, then PAY-712B to DEST-NORTH-84 accepted and settled. The audit shows a successful manual override on PAY-712B.
